correctness.rationale: Exhaustively counted all 2^21 labeled tournaments, selecting exactly 2,640 with all outdegrees three. Directly generated the three proposed mask orbits under all 7! relabellings: sizes 720,1680,240, pairwise disjoint, covering exactly 2,640 orientations; automorphism orders 7,3,21. For masks 17976,22066,85298 independently reconstructed 2,927,2,923,2,941 faces including empty; built greedy acyclic matchings (1407,1414,1410 pairs), oriented Hasse graphs and integer Morse matrices. Exact Smith forms have only unit nonzero factors, respectively ranks d3=(1,0,3), d4=(18,11,18), d5=(0,0,0), giving free reduced integral Betti triples (13,43,17),(12,44,15),(15,38,24). Independent counts of directed Hamiltonian cycles rooted at vertex zero agree with 17,15,24. Verified the three orbits exhaust, rather than relying on representatives alone. All computations are exact and finite for order 7; homotopy classification is not claimed.

value.rationale: Regular seven-vertex tournaments form exactly three natural symmetry types, and arc multipath complexes study directed path packing rather than flag/topological neighborhood complexes. An exhaustive integral homology census cleanly distinguishes those three types and locates the two uncomputed cases beyond known Paley data. The exact triplets and torsion-freeness are natural reusable invariants, with an independent Hamiltonian-cycle agreement.

final_claim: The three isomorphism classes of regular seven-vertex tournaments are distinguished by integral reduced multipath Betti triples (13,43,17), (12,44,15), (15,38,24), all other reduced groups vanish and no torsion occurs.
